pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp edge gradients. Patch size is largest on the neck and upper flank, with a noticeable decrease in spatial area towards the lower flank and posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent triple-junction nodes. The pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, narrowing where patches become more densely packed on the lower body.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible dark mane along the upper neck and shoulder with a jagged 1D profile against the background. Serration frequency is high with low-to-moderate amplitude.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical linear indentation or scar is visible on the mid-flank, appearing as a structural break across the horizontal continuity of several patches.
